Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human mTOR kinase (CHEMBL2842). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, join assays to target_dictionary on tid, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL2842. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
